question: Under the frozen centered and shifted two-point lift laws, how many rational relations arise among accepted curves for the primitive 14-vector family, with every original auxiliary-search probe charged?
vectors: same ordered primitive (a,b) family as the pinned family result: 1<=a<=3, 1<=abs(b)<=3, gcd(a,abs(b))=1
rows: all 30,008 saved target-query rows in each lift arm; verify uncompressed row hashes and exact ordinal candidate positions
reconstruction: for accepted rows with a public reduced-family hit, select auxiliary residues from the archived attempts_7 and attempts_11 ordinals, rebuild the centered CRT curve, verify curve and point reductions, then test the rational group relation
cost_accounting: charge all archived auxiliary probes and all public family-vector tests per arm; report rational group tests separately; ordinal reconstruction work is a replay diagnostic, not a replacement for the archived probe charge
positive_control: the fixed (1,2) rational hit counts and first hits must equal the centered and shifted parent records
claim_boundary: exact finite-panel rational relation yield and operation counts under the two frozen lift laws; no isolated wall-time comparison or generalized coefficient search
